name: Behalf.bot - SaaS exit
description: Playbook for helping the owner leave a hosted SaaS (course and membership platforms such as Podia, Kajabi, Teachable or Thinkific, storefronts, newsletters) for a self-hosted parity app the agent builds. Deadline first, inventory by buyers, originals before scraping, verified media capture, verbatim text capture, exports, a cutover checklist, and a reference-led design process. Docs only: no scripts, no dependencies, read-only on the old platform until cutover.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the skill does not trigger.

activation._note: On-demand. Invoked when the owner wants to leave a SaaS platform or asks the agent to rebuild one. No scheduled jobs.

system.name: browser automation
system._explanation: Soft dependency. Used read-only to walk the old platform and capture page text and links. Without it the owner pastes or exports text by hand and the playbook still holds.

system.name: shared file storage
system.install: provided by the install (for example a Google Drive connector)
system._explanation: Soft dependency. The owner drops downloaded media into one folder per product and the agent pulls and verifies it. Any shared folder the agent can read works.
